summary: @or-sdk/notifications ships install-time dropper that fetches Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases archive, extracts and chmods it executable in a temp directory, and then invokes it against `math_init.js` — a tarball-shipped 727KB single-line JavaScript bundle obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (large numeric/string constant array shuffled by a rotator function, hex-named identifiers). setup.mjs itself uses the same hex-identifier and property-indirection obfuscation to hide its child_process/https/fs calls. The package's declared purpose is a notifications SDK — a Zod-schema wrapper whose only declared dependencies are `@or-sdk/base` and `zod`, with a pure-TypeScript `dist/`. There is no native-build or runtime rationale for fetching a separate JavaScript runtime at install time or for executing a 700KB opaque payload named `math_init.js`. The alternate-runtime shape (running the payload under freshly-fetched Bun rather than the Node process performing the install) evades Node-resolved static analysis of the payload's behavior. Cover-story naming (`math_init`) and obfuscation of both the loader and the payload are consistent with deliberate concealment of install-time code execution against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
